fixed_income.title: Fixed Income
fixed_income.intro: Contract terms, historical accrual and explicit redemptions.
fixed_income.synthetic_notice: Fictional contracts and simulated historical rates/prices. Not verified offers or current market quotes.
fixed_income.empty_detail: Subscriptions require explicit product terms and funded BRL investment accounts. The isolated demo contains five fictional examples.
fixed_income.compare_guide: Open each CDB row. Compare 100%, 110% and 120% of daily CDI with the fixed 13.50% contract, their actual holding periods, estimated taxes and lock-ups. These are fictional terms.
fixed_income.selic_guide: Select Inspect Tesouro Selic. Examine the fractional acquisition, price history and July price decline. The simulated Selic-over path and changing market spread are separate from CDI and the policy target.
fixed_income.fgc_limited: Eligible product type; issuer/member and statutory limits still apply. Fictional example, no actual guarantee.
fixed_income.selic_notice: Dated market prices include spread effects. Early sales can lose value. Daily liquidity is subject to business-day settlement, cutoffs and market availability; this is not an executable quote.
fixed_income.cdb_notice: Gross contractual accrual uses business days from settlement (inclusive) to valuation (exclusive), capped at maturity. CDI percentages multiply each daily rate, not the annual yield.
fixed_income.tax_notice: Resident-individual estimate only: regressive IR on positive gains after IOF; IOF before 30 calendar days. No daily tax deduction. Excludes custody/agent fees and special tax regimes; not a formal tax calculation.
fixed_income.redemption_notice: Record a completed settlement only. Preview calculates estimated taxes and net cash. Confirmation posts one sale; principal repayment is not household income.

parity.index_notice: Use a verified daily factor with a decimal point, up to 18 places. No annual rate conversion is implied.
parity.projection_notice: Actual savings, required progress and a hypothetical contribution plan. No investment returns are assumed.
parity.event_intro: Connect life moments to their real spending. Associations never create additional expenses.
parity.delete_event_confirm: Delete this event and its associations? Ledger transactions will be preserved.
parity.missing_fx: Incomplete total: some transactions lack eligible dated FX. Original amounts remain available.
parity.event_refunds: Linked refunds follow their purchase and reduce cost on the credit date, including refunds after the event. Transfers and salary are excluded.
parity.period_flow: Income was {{income}} and net cash flow was {{net}}.
parity.spending_change: {{category}} changed by {{amount}} versus the comparable prior period.
parity.new_category: {{category}} has spending this period and none in the comparable prior period.
parity.quiet_category: No current spending in {{category}}, versus {{amount}} previously.
parity.projected_spending: At the average pace so far, month-end spending projects to {{amount}}. This is a simple projection, not a prediction.
parity.accrual_not_income: Unrealized accrual is not paid income. Redemptions release principal plus a separate realized result; they are not dividends.
parity.subscription_notice: Record completed purchases only. Product terms are immutable; review available cash before recording.
parity.partial_performance: Performance coverage is incomplete; inspect Details.
parity.value_not_return: Portfolio value includes contributions. Period gain and TWR use this same historical period; neither is the change in portfolio value.
parity.known_holdings_only: Only fully valued holdings are ranked; coverage is incomplete.
parity.income_average_context: Includes empty months and partial boundary months. Recorded income only; no prior-period comparison is available.
parity.reopen_statement: Reopen this statement and invalidate later statements for this account? Ledger entries will be preserved.
parity.valid_period: Choose a valid start and end date.
parity.goal_separate_scope: Current savings; separate from the historical portfolio period
parity.actual_progress: Recorded savings and allocations; the contribution scenario below is separate.
parity.observation_history_unavailable: At least two dated observations are needed to chart history.
parity.monthly_target_context: Monthly targets remain separate from this selected spending period.

pluggy.title: Pluggy connections
pluggy.description: Connect institutions and review provider data before importing into your local ledger.
pluggy.privacy: Optional external service: Pluggy processes connected financial data on its servers. Credentials stay in your OS vault; imported evidence stays in local SQLite. No payment initiation or automatic posting.
pluggy.acknowledge: I understand Pluggy processes my connected financial data externally.
pluggy.forget_confirm: Remove local credentials and pause retrieval? Local financial history will be preserved.
pluggy.missing_item: This connection is unavailable. Choose another connection.
pluggy.revoke_confirm: Revoke {{name}} and delete that Item at Pluggy? This ends the external connection; local evidence and ledger history will be preserved. Also revoke bank-side authorization in your bank if needed.
pluggy.refresh_explanation: A bank refresh is asynchronous at Pluggy. Retrieve provider data after it completes. No public webhook server or automatic ledger posting is required.
pluggy.no_resources: No collected records for this product
pluggy.observation_only: These are dated provider observations, not additional assets, balances or ledger postings. Pending records remain evidence until posted.
pluggy.mapping_explanation: Map to an existing same-currency account (and asset for investments). Mapping never creates an opening balance or copies a provider balance into the ledger. Existing mappings are protected.
pluggy.charges_explanation: Select activities on this page and explicitly verify fees and taxes (enter 0 only when verified). The next workbench validates cash, funding, positions and duplicates before confirmation. Provider snapshots never create holdings.
pluggy.verify_charges: I verified the selected activities and charges against the provider evidence.
pluggy.select_activities: Select at least one activity on this page.
pluggy.failed: Pluggy operation failed. Retry or check the connection.
pluggy.connect_failed: Connection was not completed. Try reconnecting through Pluggy.
pluggy.demo_disabled: External Pluggy connections and credential access are disabled in the isolated demo. Use a normal local workspace.
pluggy.investment_review_scope: Provider activities / explicit review / no cash or holdings changes until confirmation

real_market.disclosure: Historical simulation: actual market observations, fictional holdings and contracts. Fixed replay through September 30, 2026.
real_market.goal_funding: This goal reserves the Caixinha investment account. Progress includes contributions and gross accrued returns, without adding an asset. Estimated redemption taxes are shown separately.
